title: Heat pump or gas furnace
summary: Whether a heat pump or a gas furnace costs less to run through a Minneapolis winter, from one question, with a calculator added later by drawing on the page.

made.request: I am deciding whether to replace a gas furnace with a heat pump in a cold-climate home (think Minneapolis winters). Research it properly and write me a sourced report: how well today's cold-climate heat pumps really perform below freezing, what they cost to install and to run compared with gas, which US incentives exist right now, and when a heat pump does not make sense. Use charts where numbers help, check every figure against its source, and tell me plainly what you could not confirm.
